title: reisalin_stout
body:
The main protagonist of the [[Atelier Ryza]] trilogy. An ordinary girl with a spunky attitude, and a talented alchemist. Character design by [[Mirri]], voiced by [[Juno]]. 

She gained memetic status for her [[thick thighs]], [[large breasts]], [[huge ass]], and short red shorts, a notable departure from the slender figures, skirts, and dresses typical of heroines from the Atelier franchise.
